docRequirement: slash-commands.md:212 binds `/clear` as a dispatchable session command: "The `/clear` command resets the conversation to an empty context, so subsequent prompts start with no prior conversation history. The previous conversation remains on disk and can be returned to by passing its session ID to the [`resume` option]". The page's intro (:9) and the `system/init` example (:26) list `clear` beside `compact` in `slash_commands`. Two qualifiers scope the fix rather than excuse it: :214 says a one-shot `query()` already starts empty so `/clear` there has no practical effect (ours are NOT empty — every turn passes `resume`), and :217 gates it on Claude Code v2.1.117+ (bundled SDK is @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk 0.3.183, binary 2.1.183).
current: Nothing in the product implements a context reset for `/clear`; it is submitted to the model as prose on every backend. (1) The one classifier that decides "this text is an instruction to the SESSION" claims only `/compact` and `/subtask`: `parseSessionCommand`, packages/shared/src/slash-commands/session-command.ts:45 (COMPACT_PATTERN :38, subtask :54). (2) The single send seam therefore composes turn context onto the front of `/clear`: `BaseAgent.chat`, packages/shared/src/agent/base-agent.ts:2758 returns early only when `parseSessionCommand(message)` is truthy; otherwise it builds `messageParts = [capabilityContext, branchSeedContext, transferredSessionContext, continuationRestore, pinnedSkills, runtimeSkillContext, cleanMessage]` (base-agent.ts:2816-2817), so the slash is no longer leading. (3) ClaudeAgent's own allowlist excludes it: `const SDK_SLASH_COMMANDS = ['compact'] as const;` packages/shared/src/agent/claude-agent.ts:1665, matched at :1670-1674 — and by then the message is already context-prefixed, so the `^\/([a-z]+)` match cannot fire anyway. The message goes to `buildTextPrompt` (claude-agent.ts:2429-2468), which pushes `contextParts` first and the user text last, into `query({ prompt, options })` at claude-agent.ts:1702 with `resume: this.sessionId` still set (claude-agent.ts:1607-1610). (4) PiAgent has the same hole: `chatImpl` classifies with the same function (pi-agent.ts:6477) and `runSessionCommand` (pi-agent.ts:6355) has arms for `compact` and `subtask` only. (5) The implementation functions exist and are dead: `clearSessionMessages` (packages/shared/src/sessions/storage.ts:457, doc-comment :454 "Used for /clear command") has no production caller — `grep -rna` finds only its re-export at packages/shared/src/sessions/index.ts:67; `clearHistory` is implemented on all four backends (base-agent.ts:1605, claude-agent.ts:2745, pi-agent.ts:7151, nestor-cloud-agent.ts:194) and every non-test caller is absent (only pinned-capability-delivery.test.ts:152, pi-agent-lifecycle-hooks.test.ts:186, session-start-compact.test.ts:236/:257). (6) The command is nevertheless shipped and user-reachable: menu entry `clearCommand` — id `clear`, label "Clear", description "Clear the current conversation" — apps/electron/src/renderer/components/ui/slash-command-menu.tsx:162-167; exposed to every backend by `slash: { commandIds: 'all' }`, packages/shared/src/agent/backend/composer-capabilities.ts:103; `dispatchSlashCommandAction` falls past every UI-handler branch to `MESSAGE_COMMANDS.clear = '/clear'` (apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/input/slash-command-actions.ts:55-57, :138-145) and calls `submitCommand`, wired to `onSubmit(command, undefined)` at apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/input/FreeFormInput.tsx:1034 — an ordinary message. Asserted as intended today by apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/input/__tests__/slash-command-actions.test.ts:112-123.
divergence: The delta is the whole mechanism, not a key name or a value: no code path anywhere resets conversation context in response to `/clear`. Three specific gaps, in the order they must be closed. (a) CLASSIFICATION — `parseSessionCommand` (session-command.ts:45) does not claim `clear`, so `BaseAgent.chat` (:2758) prefixes turn context and the bare command stops existing before any backend sees it. (b) EXECUTION — no backend has a `clear` arm: PiAgent's `runSessionCommand` (pi-agent.ts:6355) handles `compact`/`subtask` only, and ClaudeAgent's `SDK_SLASH_COMMANDS` (claude-agent.ts:1665) is `['compact']`. (c) EFFECT — the two functions that would do the work (`clearSessionMessages`, storage.ts:457; `clearHistory`, base-agent.ts:1605 and the three overrides) have zero production callers. Note the fix is NOT "add 'clear' to SDK_SLASH_COMMANDS": per slash-commands.md:214 an SDK-dispatched `/clear` inside our per-turn one-shot `query()` is not what produces empty context — dropping the `resume:` anchor (`this.sessionId = null`, already implemented in ClaudeAgent.clearHistory at :2745) is. Also note ClaudeAgent.clearHistory (:2745-2752) never calls `super.clearHistory()`, so even the existing dead implementation would skip the base resets at base-agent.ts:1606-1618.

change.what: Add `export interface ParsedClearCommand { kind: 'clear' }`, add it to the `ParsedSessionCommand` union (:36), and add a `const CLEAR_PATTERN = /^\/clear$/i` arm in `parseSessionCommand` (:45) returning `{ kind: 'clear' }`. Whole-message match only, same discipline as COMPACT_PATTERN (:38) — `/clear` takes no argument. About 6 lines; this is the gate, nothing downstream can see the command until it is claimed here.

Bind the parsed command instead of discarding it: `const sessionCommand = parseSessionCommand(message); if (sessionCommand) { ... }`. For `sessionCommand.kind === 'clear'`, execute it HERE and return without calling `chatImpl` — `await Promise.resolve(this.clearHistory())` (the base is sync, the Pi and Nestor overrides are async), then `this.config.onSdkSessionIdCleared?.()` (the existing persistence seam, already used at base-agent.ts:2008 and claude-agent.ts:1954), then yield `{ type: 'info', message: <cleared> }` and `{ type: 'complete' }`. Every other kind keeps today's `yield* this.chatImpl(message.trim(), ...)`. Doing it at the seam rather than per backend is what makes one edit cover Claude, Pi, Codex and Nestor Cloud.

One-line fix in `clearHistory`: add `super.clearHistory()` at the end — the override nulls `this.sessionId`, `pinnedPreferencesPrompt`, `pinnedIncludeCoAuthoredBy` and `preferencesDriftNotified` but never runs the base resets (`forgetDeliveredPinnedCapabilityContext`, `prerequisiteManager.resetReadState()`, skill-invocation state, usage tracker — base-agent.ts:1606-1618). Leave `SDK_SLASH_COMMANDS` as `['compact']` and say why in the comment at :1662-1664: with `resume` dropped, the next `query()` starts empty, which is the documented effect (slash-commands.md:212/:214); dispatching `/clear` into a one-shot query would not produce it.

Add `override async clearHistory(): Promise<void>` that nulls `this.threadId` (field :99; today only nulled in teardown at :714) and calls `super.clearHistory()`. Without it a `/clear` on the Codex backend resets shared state while the next turn still resumes the same `thread/resume` id (:418-422), i.e. history survives the clear.

change.what: The transcript half. `isSessionCommand` (:15095) picks up the new kind for free (model-only context is correctly skipped). Do NOT call this from the agent layer — it writes a StoredSession behind SessionManager's back and `enqueuePersist` (SessionManager.ts:7776-7790) rebuilds the snapshot from `managed.messages` on the next persist, silently undoing it. Either delete it (its doc-comment at :454 claims a caller that has never existed) or move it behind the SessionManager reset above.

blastRadius: Crosses a persistence boundary, so it is a risk trigger in this repo. (1) `parseSessionCommand` is the product's single command classifier and is read by three layers: `BaseAgent.chat` (base-agent.ts:2758, the send seam for all four backends and therefore for every RPC, automation, queued and headless send), `PiAgent.chatImpl` (pi-agent.ts:6477), and the MODEL-facing `SlashCommand` tool `PiAgent.dispatchSlashCommand` (pi-agent.ts:5404) — there, a `clear` kind falls past the `parsed?.kind === 'compact'` branch to the `Unknown or blocked slash command` throw at :5424, which is the /subtask precedent and the safe default; keep it, and leave the agent-callable list in the /help text (:5416-5422) unchanged. (2) `SessionManager.sendMessage` reads the classifier at :15095 to suppress model-only context and held task notifications; a new truthy kind changes that turn's shape. (3) PERSISTENCE/WIRE: `managed.messages` and `managed.sdkSessionId` are persisted via `persistSession` → `enqueuePersist` → sessionStore (SessionManager.ts:7718-7790, StoredSession/session.jsonl) and streamed to renderer and CLI/remote clients over the RPC event stream; the `info`/`complete` events the arm yields ride the same `dto.ts:372` channel that `compaction_complete` uses. (4) AUTOMATIONS: the SessionEnd/SessionStart `clear` reason and source become reachable for the FIRST time — pi-agent.ts:7152 and :7164, nestor-cloud-agent.ts:195, vocabulary at packages/shared/src/automations/types.ts:175-181 — so user hooks matching `clear` start firing; tests session-start-compact.test.ts:252-258 and pi-agent-lifecycle-hooks.test.ts:180 already pin that behaviour. (5) UI copy that references the command: slash-command-menu.tsx:162 + TRANSLATED_COMMAND_IDS :324, and the /context over-limit warnings at apps/electron/src/renderer/components/app-shell/context-overlay.tsx:139-142 with i18n keys `context.warning.overLimitClear` / `context.warning.pastCompactionWindowClear` (packages/shared/src/i18n/locales/en.json:601/:603, ru.json:603/:605). (6) No imported-plugin path is involved; `/clear` is a built-in, not a plugin command.
userImpact: Directly observable on every backend, today. The composer "/" menu ships "Clear — Clear the current conversation" (slash-command-menu.tsx:162-167). Selecting it submits the literal text `/clear` as an ordinary turn (slash-command-actions.ts:57 → FreeFormInput.tsx:1034): the user sees their own "/clear" message in the transcript, the model replies to it as prose, a full context-wrapped turn is billed, and nothing is cleared — the next turn still resumes the same SDK/Pi session with the entire history (claude-agent.ts:1607-1610). Sharper case: when auto-compaction is off and the session is over the window, the /context overlay instructs exactly this action — "Context exceeds the {{limit}}-token limit by {{over}} tokens — run /clear to continue." (en.json:601) — so the product's own documented recovery is a no-op and the session stays stuck over the window; the only real exit is starting a new session. Also silently latent: no SessionStart `clear` source or SessionEnd `clear` reason ever fires, so a user automation matching `clear` never runs.
